run_denoiser_module: run the DenoiserModule to apply Demucs denoising to audio files from a manifest TSV
create_denoiser_config: create a DenoiserConfig dataclass with model name, output directory, and dry wet ratio
denoise_audio_tensor: call the denoise method on a torch tensor to separate vocals from background noise
calc_snr_waveforms: compute the signal-to-noise ratio between original and denoised audio waveforms
write_audio_wav: normalize and save a torch audio tensor to a 16-bit PCM WAV file on disk
